subject: Bridge letter request to cover post-report window — Calyx Systems
messages:
From: Sarah Delgado <security@calyxsystems.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: bridge letter to cover post-report period (SOC 2 T2 ended 2026-12-31)

Hi Markus,

Hope you’re doing well — Calyx here. We are finalizing our vendor assessment and need a short bridge letter to cover the period between the SOC 2 Type II report end date (2026-12-31) and today. Our auditor has asked for an attestation that there have been no material changes in the controls described in the report and to call out any excluded subservice providers or scope changes since the report date.

Specifics:
- Recipient: Calyx Systems (security@calyxsystems.com) for internal records and our third-party auditor.
- Period to cover: 2027-01-01 through 2027-05-20 (today).
- We prefer a short statement (one page) that we can upload to our vendor portal.

Could you confirm whether Redwood can provide a bridge letter and if you require any particular redaction guidance? If you have a template/draft we can review, please send it and we’ll route to our audit team.

Thanks,
Sarah Delgado
Director, Information Security
Calyx Systems
security@calyxsystems.com

Attachment: none

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Delgado <security@calyxsystems.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: bridge letter to cover post-report period (SOC 2 T2 ended 2026-12-31)

Hi Sarah — thanks for the note and context. We can provide a bridge letter to cover the requested post-report period. A few quick clarifying items before we draft:

1) Can you confirm the SOC 2 report identifier you’re referencing (vendor report date and auditor name)?
2) Do you need the statement to affirm controls remained unchanged, or are you ok with a limited-coverage bridge (e.g., "no material changes identified to Redwood controls that would affect the scope of the report")?
3) Any specific redaction rules from your auditor (PII, IP, or infrastructure details)?

I’ve looped in Laura (Legal) and Priya (Compliance) to help with wording and signatory authority. I’ll attach a short draft for your review shortly.

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com

Attachment: bridge_letter_draft_redwood_20270520.docx (draft)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Delgado <security@calyxsystems.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Request: bridge letter to cover post-report period (SOC 2 T2 ended 2026-12-31)

Markus / Priya — looping in my redlines.

Please see inline comments in the attached draft. High-level suggestions:
- Shorten the representation: state that Redwood has no knowledge of any material changes to the controls during the stated period rather than an absolute representation.
- Add a standard redaction notice: "This letter may be redacted to remove sensitive customer-identifiable information or internal escalation details."
- Signatory: Legal prefers the General Counsel or VP Legal sign this on Redwood letterhead.

Sarah — we attached a redlined draft for your review (we kept it to one page). If that looks fine, we can finalize signature via DocuSign.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

Attachment: bridge_letter_draft_redwood_20270520.docx (redlines included)

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Delgado <security@calyxsystems.com>, Tom Reynolds <treynolds@calyxsystems.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: bridge letter to cover post-report period (SOC 2 T2 ended 2026-12-31)

Hi Sarah / Tom —

Per Laura’s suggested wording we finalized a one-page bridge letter and routed it for signature. Attached is the signed version. We affirm the following in the letter:
- Report referenced: SOC 2 Type II report ending 2026-12-31, audited by Clearbrook LLP (report ID: RBW-SOC2-2026-12).
- Covered period: 2027-01-01 through 2027-05-20.
- Representation: "To the best of Redwood Inference’s knowledge, there were no material changes to the description of controls covered by the referenced report during the covered period."

Signed copy attached and also available via secure DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/recipient/embedded?token=EXAMPLE_DOCUSIGN_TOKEN

If your auditor needs any additional confirmation or a different level of statement, let me know and we’ll coordinate.

Best regards,
Markus Klein
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com

Attachments: bridge_letter_signed_redwood_20270521.pdf
